trajectory_summary: The call opens with an unusually cooperative, even enthusiastic customer who hands the rep a strong reason (pool heater on solar) and a real bill number, but the rep runs the script beats mechanically and never converts either into leverage. Energy stays flat to slightly positive throughout because the customer supplies most of the momentum herself; the rep neither builds nor damages it, and closes on a booked time without any callback to what she cares about.
